resources.string: Open your Ledgerline web profile → Connect device, and point your camera at the QR code. The camera is used only to read the pairing code — nothing is recorded or uploaded.

Encryption is byte-compatible with the web and iOS clients (libsodium + ML-KEM-768). Built against the Ledgerline API v1.

Store the vault key behind your biometrics so you don\'t re-enter the passphrase every time. The key is hardware-sealed and cleared if you add a new fingerprint or face.

Optional: sync your encrypted address book with the device contacts app. Uses a local Ledgerline account only — nothing is sent to Google or anyone else.
Optional: back up your camera roll into the encrypted gallery. Photos are read only to encrypt and upload them — nothing leaves the app in the clear.
